basis: Themes and bilingual one-sentence notes assigned individually from reviewed abstracts, explicit excerpts or authorized online short-comment review; not an automated classifier or quality rating.

categories.label: 社区发现与网络推断、重构

10.1038/s41467-026-75453-3.note_en: Examines global road-network organization and intermediary positions; modern associations do not establish causation.
10.1038/s41467-026-75453-3.note_zh: 分析罗马道路网络的整体组织及城市、路段的中介位置，并考察其与现代道路的关联。

10.1038/s42256-026-01306-9.note_en: Links task demands and capacity constraints to the emergence of modular recurrent-network topology.
10.1038/s42256-026-01306-9.note_zh: 研究任务需求和容量约束如何塑造循环网络的模块化拓扑，并与脑网络组织比较。

10.1103/g875-ldn5.note_en: Derives thermodynamic bounds for reaction networks and uses them to constrain topology and hidden pathways.
10.1103/g875-ldn5.note_zh: 推导反应网络可达稳态和反应亲和力的热力学界，用于检验候选拓扑与隐藏反应路径。

10.1103/6m2z-wlmb.note_en: Maps localized plasma wave packets to network percolation and a stability threshold; experimental validation remains pending.
10.1103/6m2z-wlmb.note_zh: 将等离子体局域波包映射为网络渗流，以临界阈值刻画全局失稳，尚待实验验证。

10.1126/science.aec3917.note_en: Studies associative-memory capacity and recall under nonequilibrium dynamics and changing spin-network connectivity.
10.1126/science.aec3917.note_zh: 研究非平衡动力学与动态连接如何改变Hopfield型自旋网络的联想记忆容量和回忆。

10.1126/sciadv.aef2894.note_en: Models self-organizing connectivity and contrasts communication efficiency with computational reliability and attack resilience.
10.1126/sciadv.aef2894.note_zh: 通过自组织网络模型揭示通信效率、计算可靠性与枢纽抗攻击能力之间的拓扑权衡。

10.1073/pnas.2614238123.note_en: Derives dynamical mean-field results linking degree distributions to starvation transitions and molecular-abundance scaling.
10.1073/pnas.2614238123.note_zh: 用动力学平均场理论连接网络度分布、代谢饥饿转变与分子丰度的标度规律。

10.1073/pnas.2537815123.note_en: Shows how topology creates independently controllable reaction-network modules and tests predicted regulatory structure.
10.1073/pnas.2537815123.note_zh: 从网络拓扑推导独立控制模块，并在细胞周期系统中检验模块与预测的反应结构。

10.1126/sciadv.aeh8819.note_en: Generates reaction-network topologies and kinetic parameters from desired dynamical functions using simulation-based evaluation.
10.1126/sciadv.aeh8819.note_zh: 从指定动力学功能反向生成反应网络拓扑与参数，以模拟评价探索网络设计方案。

10.1126/science.aeg3946.note_en: Establishes conditions under which nodal and interaction heterogeneity enhance network stability through non-Hermitian dynamics.
10.1126/science.aeg3946.note_zh: 提出节点和连接异质性在非厄米动力学条件下增强网络稳定性的跨系统理论。

10.1073/pnas.2604777123.note_en: Finds minimal temporary interventions in logical networks while preserving natural dynamics, with formal enumeration guarantees.
10.1073/pnas.2604777123.note_zh: 形式保证地寻找逻辑网络最小暂时干预，使其达到目标表型并保留自然调控动力学。

10.1038/s41467-026-77357-8.note_en: Connects a contact-network percolation threshold to tissue-wide collective motion and mechano-chemical feedback in heterogeneous tumors.
10.1038/s41467-026-77357-8.note_zh: 将细胞接触网络的渗流阈值与肿瘤群体运动及机械化学反馈联系起来。

10.1103/9y9m-q7qj.note_en: Derives how local attachment flexibility changes hierarchy and degree distributions in growing networks.
10.1103/9y9m-q7qj.note_zh: 通过随机分析和模拟揭示局部连接灵活性如何改变优先连接网络的层级与度分布。

10.1073/pnas.2613908123.note_en: Explains how neighbor communication and attention constraints generate echo chambers and impair collective decision dynamics.
10.1073/pnas.2613908123.note_zh: 解释邻居通信与注意力约束如何产生回音室状态，影响群体决策的动态可靠性。

10.1073/pnas.2526156123.note_en: Links coupled neuronal and synaptic dynamics to connectivity eigenvalues and analytically explains persistent oscillatory memory.
10.1073/pnas.2526156123.note_zh: 通过解析和模拟，将节点—突触耦合动力学及连接矩阵特征值与持续振荡记忆联系起来。

10.1038/s41467-026-76416-4.note_en: Separates link-observation propensity from true-link prediction to address missing links and uneven sampling in incomplete networks.
10.1038/s41467-026-76416-4.note_zh: 分离链接观测倾向与真实链接预测，处理不完整、偏采样网络中的宿主—病毒缺失关系。

10.1038/s41467-026-77340-3.note_en: Quantifies interaction and systematic-bias contributions to opinion shifts and shared attractors in LLM-agent discussions.
10.1038/s41467-026-77340-3.note_zh: 量化大语言模型讨论中相互作用与系统偏置对意见变化及共同吸引子的影响。

10.1103/61hq-rs8x.note_en: Compares synchronization criticality on complete graphs and locally coupled lattices, linking dimension and symmetry to universality classes.
10.1103/61hq-rs8x.note_zh: 比较完全图与局部耦合晶格上的同步临界性，研究维度和对称性如何影响普适类。

10.1126/science.aek9090.note_en: Discusses when noise and parameter heterogeneity can stabilize interacting groups, connecting oscillator synchronization and power grids.
10.1126/science.aek9090.note_zh: 评论噪声与参数异质性何时有助于集体稳定，连接振子同步、电网与相互作用系统。

10.1073/pnas.2622915123.note_en: Connects biological transport and bus networks through resource-constrained optimization, adaptive conductance, and tree or loop organization.
10.1073/pnas.2622915123.note_zh: 以资源约束优化连接生物输运与公交网络，评论导流自适应以及树、环结构的形成。
